tools.name: Deutsche Bundesbank MCP
tools.description: Queries Bundesbank statistical time series such as interest rates, exchange rates and banking statistics.
tools.pricing: Free: 50 calls/day anonymous, 200/day with free account; paid credits beyond

tools.name: ECB Data Portal MCP
tools.description: Pulls European Central Bank statistics (policy rates, FX reference rates, monetary aggregates) as time series.
tools.pricing: Free: 50 calls/day anonymous, 200/day with free account; paid credits beyond

tools.name: einvoice checker MCP
tools.description: Detects, validates and renders EU e-invoices (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, Factur-X, Peppol, KSeF) with rule-level errors.
tools.pricing: Free API key with monthly quota; paid plans for more volume

tools.name: IBAN Validator & Bank Lookup
tools.description: Validates IBANs in bulk and adds bank name, BIC and city from official bank registries.
tools.access: Apify Store / API: fast_data_asap/iban-validator-bank-lookup (also via mcp.apify.com)
tools.pricing: $0.0005 per IBAN

tools.name: OpenIBAN MCP
tools.description: Checks an IBAN's checksum and bank code and resolves bank name, BIC and city via OpenIBAN.
tools.pricing: Free: 50 calls/day anonymous, 200/day with free account; paid credits beyond

tools.name: XRechnung & ZUGFeRD / Factur-X Parser
tools.description: Parses German/EU e-invoices (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, Factur-X) into JSON with parties, IBAN, totals, VAT breakdown and line items.
tools.pricing: $0.003 per parsed e-invoice

tools.name: XRechnung Validator MCP (checkxrechnung.com)
tools.description: Checks XRechnung XML and ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDFs against the current KoSIT rule set and explains each error code.
tools.access: Local MCP: npm xrechnung-validator-mcp (calls the checkxrechnung.com API)
tools.pricing: Free: 50 checks per IP per day; batch/volume plans from EUR 79/month announced

tools.name: ZUGFeRD Validator
tools.description: Validates ZUGFeRD/Factur-X and XRechnung invoices against EN 16931 and suggests corrections.
tools.pricing: See provider site

tools.name: BaFin Warnings Scraper
tools.description: Lists current BaFin investor warnings and screens company names or domains against them with a match score.
tools.access: Apify Store / API: fast_data_asap/bafin-investor-warnings (also via mcp.apify.com)
tools.pricing: $0.002 per warning returned; $0.01 per name screened

tools.name: E-Invoice Map
tools.description: Answers read-only questions on e-invoicing mandate dates by country, Peppol providers and validation error codes.
tools.pricing: Free (fair-use limits)

tools.name: EU VAT Number Validator (VIES)
tools.description: Checks EU VAT IDs against the official VIES service and returns validity plus registered name and address where shared.
tools.access: Apify Store / API: fast_data_asap/eu-vat-number-validator (also via mcp.apify.com)
tools.pricing: $0.001 per VAT number

tools.name: EU VIES MCP
tools.description: Validates EU VAT numbers live against the European Commission's VIES system, including member-state availability.
tools.pricing: Free: 50 calls/day anonymous, 200/day with free account; paid credits beyond

tools.name: EUR-Lex MCP Server
tools.description: Searches EU legislation, CJEU case law and treaties via EUR-Lex/CELLAR with EuroVoc concepts.
tools.pricing: Free, open source

tools.name: German Court Decisions
tools.description: Returns German federal court decisions (BGH, BVerfG, BAG and others) from the official open-data portal.
tools.pricing: $0.001 per decision

tools.name: German Law MCP
tools.description: Queries German federal statutes and related case law from gesetze-im-internet.de with citations.
tools.access: Local MCP: npm @ansvar/german-law-mcp; hosted gateway https://gateway.ansvar.eu/de/mcp (OAuth)
tools.pricing: Open-source package free; hosted gateway has a paid tier

tools.name: German Shop Legal Check
tools.description: Checks German online shops for common warning-letter risks such as Impressum, unit prices and accessibility notices.
tools.pricing: $0.01 per shop checked

tools.name: OpenSanctions MCP
tools.description: Searches OpenSanctions for sanctioned entities and politically exposed persons for KYC/AML screening.
tools.pricing: Free: 50 calls/day anonymous, 200/day with free account; paid credits beyond

tools.name: Sanctions Screening MCP Server
tools.description: Screens names against eleven sanctions and export-control lists (incl. EU and UN) and resolves GLEIF entities.
tools.pricing: Free, open source

tools.name: Arbeitsagentur Job Search API
tools.description: Searches German Federal Employment Agency job postings by keyword, city and radius as a hiring signal.
tools.access: Apify Store / API: fast_data_asap/job-search-api (also via mcp.apify.com)
tools.pricing: $0.0025 per job

tools.name: Arbeitsagentur Jobs Feed
tools.description: Exports job listings from Germany's federal employment agency portal with filters for location and occupation.
tools.access: Apify Store / API: blackfalcondata/arbeitsagentur-jobs-feed (also via mcp.apify.com)
tools.pricing: From $0.45 per 1,000 jobs (tiered)

tools.name: Career Site Jobs Scraper
tools.description: Reads all open jobs from company career sites (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever and more) with a new-jobs-only mode.
tools.access: Apify Store / API: fast_data_asap/career-site-jobs-api (also via mcp.apify.com)
tools.pricing: $0.002 per job

tools.name: German Newsfeed MCP (tagesschau.de)
tools.description: Reads current German national and regional news from the public tagesschau.de API for company and market monitoring.
tools.pricing: Free, open source

tools.name: StepStone Jobs Scraper (Germany)
tools.description: Collects structured job listings from StepStone Germany to spot which companies are hiring for what.
tools.access: Apify Store / API: valig/stepstone-jobs-scraper (also via mcp.apify.com)
tools.pricing: From $0.40 per 1,000 jobs (tiered)

tools.name: Ausschreibungsagenten Tender Search
tools.description: Searches public procurement notices from 17 German, EU and UK sources, always linking to the original notice.
tools.pricing: Free tier (rate-limited); agent tier free during pilot

tools.name: Bundestag DIP MCP
tools.description: Searches the Bundestag documentation system (DIP) for bills, printed papers and plenary proceedings.
tools.pricing: Free: 50 calls/day anonymous, 200/day with free account; paid credits beyond

tools.name: Destatis MCP
tools.description: Queries official German statistics tables from Destatis GENESIS-Online.
tools.pricing: Free: 50 calls/day anonymous, 200/day with free account; paid credits beyond

tools.name: EU Funding & Tenders MCP
tools.description: Searches calls for proposals and tenders on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal.
tools.pricing: Free: 50 calls/day anonymous, 200/day with free account; paid credits beyond

tools.name: EU TED Tenders Scraper
tools.description: Fetches EU procurement notices, contract awards and RFPs from the official TED API.
tools.access: Apify Store / API: foxlabs/ted-tenders (also via mcp.apify.com)
tools.pricing: $0.004 per result

tools.name: Eurostat MCP Server
tools.description: Searches and queries the Eurostat catalogue for EU economic, demographic, trade and regional data.
tools.pricing: Free, open source

tools.name: German Public Tenders (service.bund.de)
tools.description: Searches current German public tenders from the federal procurement portal with deadlines and links.
tools.access: Apify Store / API: fast_data_asap/german-public-tenders-bund (also via mcp.apify.com)
tools.pricing: $0.002 per tender

tools.name: Germany Tenders MCP
tools.description: Lists official German government tender notices without needing an API key.
tools.pricing: Free: 50 calls/day anonymous, 200/day with free account; paid credits beyond

tools.name: TenderAPI
tools.description: Searches EU tenders from TED and national portals by CPV code, country, buyer or contract value.
tools.pricing: Free sign-up; paid plans (see pricing page)

tools.name: Vergabeweiser
tools.description: Searches German public tenders and contract awards with deadlines, winners and market figures from open data.
tools.pricing: Free, no sign-up (rate-limited)

tools.name: Agentic Firmenbuch (Handelsregister + Firmenbuch MCP)
tools.description: Gives master data, financials and ratios for companies in the German Handelsregister and Austrian Firmenbuch.
tools.pricing: Free: 25 companies/month; paid plans from EUR 29/month

tools.name: Bundesanzeiger Scraper
tools.description: Retrieves published annual financial statements and filings from the German Federal Gazette with parsed key figures.
tools.access: Apify Store / API: memo23/bundesanzeiger-scraper (also via mcp.apify.com)
tools.pricing: $0.0015 per publication; $0.005 per run start

tools.name: Entyrix MCP
tools.description: Provides KYB company briefs, financials, ownership and AML screening from 23 European business registers.
tools.pricing: Free start tier; paid plans (see site)

tools.name: GLEIF LEI MCP
tools.description: Looks up Legal Entity Identifiers and parent/child relationships from the GLEIF database.
tools.pricing: Free: 50 calls/day anonymous, 200/day with free account; paid credits beyond

tools.name: Handelsregister API
tools.description: Fetches live company data from handelsregister.de: register court and number, status, address and official documents.
tools.access: Apify Store / API: radeance/handelsregister-api (also via mcp.apify.com)
tools.pricing: $0.025 per result; add-ons $0.005-$0.10; $0.01 per run start
